entity_raw.definition_raw:
You are skilled at riding slurks into battle.

Prerequisite(s): Kobold.

Benefit(s): You are able to control, guide, and communicate with slurks, as if they understood Draconic. You can also spend a standard action to manipulate the nodules on the slurk’s back to activate its slime ability. Both you and the slurk can activate this ability during the same round.
